_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Get a company's head count over time...

description: Get one company's number of employees now and every dated count Wikidata holds (newest first), from a domain (such as stripe.com) or a name (such as Siemens AG). A name can match several items: other_matches lists them, so send the domain for a sure match. Counts are as reported for their date and can lag. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

domain.description: The company's domain, such as stripe.com (a URL or work email also works).

name.description: The company's name, such as Siemens AG; used when no domain is sent.

name: data_company_headcount
title: Get a company's head count over time
